column1: # Read-only snapshot of the local variables of the Figma file "ds-3tier-v2" (2026-10-28), the target
# structure for Figma output. One line per variable, in Figma order:
#   name <TAB> type (C=COLOR F=FLOAT S=STRING) <TAB> value <TAB> scopes (* = ALL_SCOPES, - = none) <TAB> h (hidden from publishing)
# Values: #hex, number, "string", @<collection initial>:<variable name> for aliases,
# {"color":@…,"opacity":@…} for a colour with an aliased opacity.
# Aliases to deleted variables are kept with the name Figma still resolves (color/iron/*, color/lemon-tbd/*).
